title: Vanilla Diet+
description: It makes food choices in Minecraft more meaningful while staying true to the vanilla experience. It adds cooked eggs, and milk bottle.
body:
![Vanila Diet+](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0382459ce957dd88a1e75e2b5c4c4bd4a79e1670.jpeg)

Each food starts with a small saturation bonus, but eating the same item repeatedly will gradually reduce its effectiveness. After 10 uses, the bonus disappears, and after 20, a light penalty kicks. The penalty is intentionally mild, encouraging variety rather than restricting gameplay.

Mixing different foods helps you maintain the bonus and avoid penalties, rewarding a balanced diet. Raw food provides no bonus and comes with a slight downside.


The datapack also adds:

- A craftable Diet Book (shapeless recipe: book, apple, golden carrot, egg)
- Stackable milk bottles (up to 64)
- Cooked eggs (smeltable, all egg types supported)
- Dried Pumpkin Seeds
- Mushroom Stew Bottle
- Rabbit Stew Bottle
- Bottled Better Soup

Requirements:

- Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.5-26.1.2

Installation:

Singleplayer
- Open Minecraft
- Create a new world and click on "More", "Data Packs"
- Drag the data pack into the Minecraft window
- Click "Yes" on the confirmation screen
- Move the data pack to the right-hand side of the screen by clicking the triangle on its icon
- Click "Done" and continue creating your world, then click on "Create New World"

Multiplayer
- Download the data pack
- Open your server folder, then open the folder of the world
- Put the data pack into a folder named datapacks
- Restart your server and you can use your new datapack.

Permissions:
- None

Commands:
- None
